item.title: Can Kenya’s AI ambitions coexist with Naivasha’s water needs?
item.description: As Kenya courts data-centre investment, communities fear growing pressure on an already stressed water system.

item.title: Ebola cases in DRC hit 5,515 as Pope Leo urges global action to save lives
item.description: Case fatality rate climbs to nearly 48 percent in DRC, meaning almost one in two people infected with Ebola are dying.

item.title: India crushes cockroach dissent as ‘Fix Schools’ campaign riles Modi
item.description: The Cockroach Janta Party’s ‘Fix the Schools’ campaign in India is facing pushback from BJP leaders and supporters.

item.title: Large forest fire burns close to residential areas in Ankara
item.description: A large forest fire is threatening homes near residential areas of Mamak on the outskirts of the Turkish capital.

item.title: Tokayev allies head for landslide victory in Kazakhstan elections
item.description: Exit polls give Kazakhstan’s pro-Tokayev Adilet party about 70 percent of the vote in the parliamentary elections.

item.title: Iran war live: Iranian parliament advances plans for Hormuz service fees
item.description: Draft law says ships of countries permitted to pass through the Strait of Hormuz will pay for Tehran's services.

item.title: Raphinha and Lopez score braces as Barcelona trounce Elche 5-0
item.description: Barcelona ‌begin their La Liga title ⁠defence ⁠and bid for a third successive crown with a 5-0 ⁠victory at Elche.

item.title: Will Donald Trump’s new sanctions against Iran work?
item.description: The US president says he will impose 'crushing measures' on Tehran.

item.title: Serbia requests international assistance to battle wildfires
item.description: Serbia requested assistance from the European Union and Russia to help bring intense wildfires under control.

item.title: US envoy Tom Barrack retracts comment that Syria’s Golan is occupied
item.description: Ambassador to Turkiye says US policy of recognising Israel's claimed sovereignty over Syrian territory is 'unchanged'.

item.title: Landfill collapse kills 30 in Guinea’s capital after heavy rains
item.description: A mound of waste collapsed at a landfill in Conakry, Guinea, after heavy overnight rains, engulfing nearby homes.

item.title: Is Israel about to split the occupied West Bank in half?
item.description: Israel is moving forward with its ‘E1’ plan. What is it and why could it threaten the future of a Palestinian state?

item.title: Severe winds toss four aircraft across Italian airport tarmac
item.description: Winds reaching around 120 km/h swept through Forlì in Italy’s Emilia-Romagna region, overturning four light aircraft.

item.title: Photos: IndyCars speed past Washington landmarks as part of Freedom 250
item.description: Race cars take over central Washington, DC, as the Trump-created Freedom 250 Grand Prix debuts.

item.title: Gaza’s hospitals are running out of oxygen as healthcare nears collapse
item.description: Gaza’s hospitals face oxygen shortages, putting the lives of premature babies and critically ill patients at risk.

item.title: Two killed after giant Ganesha statue collapses onto crowd in Mumbai
item.description: Two people were killed after a massive Ganesha idol fell onto a crowd during a procession in Mumbai, India.

item.title: Zhou Bo: China’s alternative to Western power
item.description: Senior Colonel Zhou Bo and Sreenivasan Jain discuss China's vision of a fairer, multipolar world and work towards that.

item.title: Palestinian teen killed in Israeli raid buried in Occupied West Bank
item.description: Hundreds attended the funeral of 14-year-old Islam Ahmad Maher Ajouri, who was killed by Israeli gunfire during a raid.

item.title: Video: Thousands of families flee fighting in Sudan’s North Kordofan State
item.description: Mothers and their children are in dire need of food and safety in Sudan’s conflict-stricken Kordofan State.

item.title: Trump has ‘run out of options’ in Iran war: Stephen Walt
item.description: Political scientist Stephen Walt says Trump promised to make US stronger, but many of his policies are making it weaker.

item.title: Tunisia sees protests after migrant boat sinking kills eight
item.description: A migrant boat carrying 15 Tunisians sank off the country's southeastern coast while heading to Italy, killing eight.

item.title: Thousands displaced as wildfire threatens homes in US state of Nevada
item.description: Authorities said the fire was caused by humans.

item.title: Iran war: Top US lawmaker says Republicans can ‘absolutely’ win midterms
item.description: House Speaker Mike Johnson, a Trump ally, admits it 'would be helpful' if conflict ends before elections in November.

item.title: Landfill collapse in Guinea kills at least 30 people
item.description: Heavy rains wash over the site, triggering a landslide that buries several shacks.

item.title: Photos: Ukraine celebrates National Flag Day
item.description: People observe a minute of silence for those killed in war to mark the holiday established in 2004.
